description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe seated under a geranium plant near a window in her Abiquiu house. She is wearing a  white collared long sleeved jacket over a white collared shirt with a round silver hand-hammered dome button / pin at the neck, and a broomstick-type skirt with her hands clasped over her knee. On the windowsill  is a coiled ceramic snake,some rocks and 2 other unidentified forms.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
